## Summary
Link the maintainer operations runbook from `README.md` so repository users can discover it from the main project documentation.

Parent: #3

## Acceptance Criteria
- Update `README.md` to link to the maintainer operations runbook created for this feature.
- Keep the change limited to documentation.
- Preserve existing README structure and wording outside the minimal link addition needed for discoverability.

## Tests To Run
- `pwsh -NoProfile -File tests/Test-AiWorkflow.ps1`
